company_name: ZHENGZHOU HONG TUO PRECISION TOOLS CO.,LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in superabrasive tools used in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Zhengzhou Hongtuo Precision Tools Co., Ltd is a high-tech company focused on the R&D, production, sale, and service of superabrasive tools, particularly diamond and CBN cutting wheels and grinding wheels. Their products are designed for precision cutting and grinding in the semiconductor and micro-electronics sectors, ensuring high accuracy and longer tool life.
